description: Lists large buys, sells, bridges, and transfers for one EVM wallet on Base, Ethereum, and Arbitrum in a 1-72h window, plus optional Hyperliquid positions and large fills. Use to watch one wallet's recent moves; for that account's margin health use `position_health_check`; paid 0.11 USDC via x402.

chains.description: Chains to scan. Default is base, ethereum, and arbitrum.

include_hyperliquid.description: If true, include Hyperliquid positions and large fills.

min_usd.description: Only report moves at least this large in USD.

wallet_address.description: EVM wallet to check (0x plus 40 hex chars).

name: wallet_watch_alert
title: Wallet Watch Alert
